panel.title: Open a Support Ticket
panel.description: Click the button below to open a ticket. A staff member will be with you shortly.

welcome_message:
👋 Welcome {user}! Please fill out the intake form below.

💬 **Send a message in this channel to cancel the auto-close timer** and keep your ticket open.

When your form is complete, tag <@&1505501828727570513> to signal you're ready for review.

If you don't respond within **{initial_inactivity_minutes} minutes**, your ticket will auto-close.

task.instructions:
📋 **TikTok Account Creation & Warm-Up Task**

**Account Type:** Music Artist Fan Account
**Sample:** https://www.tiktok.com/@songinvoice?_r=1&_t=ZS-96WZqgld1nx

**1️⃣ Create Your Account**
• Connect VPN → US server
• Uninstall & reinstall TikTok while connected
• Sign up with an email 1+ year old (recommended)

**2️⃣ Warm Up the Account (2–3 Days)**
Before posting — watch hip hop/rap clips, like posts, follow similar pages, leave natural comments. Act like a real user. Do NOT post yet.

**3️⃣ Post Your Content**
After warming up, pick any clip from our Google Drive folder:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/194nsFBrheXGVu3mEjWdbjaeua8GIMXcZ
Upload to TikTok with hashtags: **#usa #moonisgod** + any relevant ones.

**4️⃣ Final Submission (24hrs after posting)**
Make a screen recording showing your TikTok profile, the post, and view analytics → upload to Google Drive → submit the link here.

⚠️ Accounts not properly warmed up may be rejected.

⏳ **First step:** send your **TikTok profile link** in this channel within **{stage1_minutes} minutes** to confirm account creation.
task.stage2_message:
✅ **TikTok link received!**

Great work <@{user}>! Now warm up your account for **2–3 days** if you haven't already — watch hip hop/rap content, like posts, follow similar pages.

When ready, pick any clip from our Drive folder:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/194nsFBrheXGVu3mEjWdbjaeua8GIMXcZ

Upload it to TikTok with hashtags: **#usa #moonisgod** + relevant ones. After **24 hours**, make a screen recording of your profile, the post, and view analytics — upload to Google Drive and submit the link here.

⏳ You have **{stage2_days} days** to submit your Drive link.
task.completed_message:
🔵 **Drive link received!**

Thank you <@{user}>! Your screen recording has been received and will be reviewed by staff shortly. Sit tight!

actions.message: ✅ Thanks {user}! Your submission has been received — your task is being assigned now. Check the next message!

dm_templates.ticket_opened:
👋 Hi {user}! Your ticket has been opened. Please fill out the intake form: {intake_form_url}

When you're done, tag @Support Staff in your ticket channel.
dm_templates.moved_to_task: 📋 Your submission has been received! A staff member is now reviewing your ticket. If accepted, you will be assigned a task — stay tuned!
dm_templates.accepted: 🎉 Congratulations {user}! Your ticket has been **accepted**. A task will be assigned to you shortly — please check your ticket channel for next steps.
dm_templates.denied_final:
📭 Your ticket was closed. Unfortunately your application was not accepted at this time.

Reason: {reason}
dm_templates.closed_inactive:
📭 Your ticket was closed due to inactivity — this does **not** mean your application was denied.

💡 **Here's What You Can Do:**
• You can open a new ticket anytime to reapply
• Make sure to complete the form promptly next time
• Staff will be happy to assist you again!
dm_templates.closed_manual: 📭 Your ticket has been closed by staff. {reason}
dm_templates.timer_warning:
⏳ Your ticket will auto-close in **{minutes} minutes** if you don't respond.

💬 Just send any message in your ticket channel to cancel the timer and keep it open.
